criteria: 16 distinct peer-reviewed SSL/pretraining/foundation approaches with direct scalp EEG evidence. Generic TS-TCC explicitly flagged. Banville objectives counted as one paper-level family. No workshops or unaccepted preprints counted.
source_policy: Conference proceedings/publisher or author institutional full publication records; access limitations retained, never silently treated as full-text inspection.

excluded.name: BrainBERT
excluded.reason: Original intracranial neural recordings; not direct scalp EEG evidence.

excluded.name: Brant
excluded.reason: Original intracranial neural recordings; not direct scalp EEG evidence.

excluded.name: MAEEG
excluded.reason: Original NeurIPS workshop publication; not used to fill main peer-reviewed conference/journal quota.

items.title: Uncovering the structure of clinical EEG signals with self-supervised learning
items.verification: Publisher URL blocked by robots; DOI/year/journal verified in author institutional manuscript and publication record. Publication year is 2021, not arXiv posting year 2020.
items.evidence_scope: Direct clinical scalp EEG: sleep staging and pathology detection; relative positioning, temporal shuffling and CPC counted as one paper-level family.

items.title: BENDR: Using Transformers and a Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning Task to Learn From Massive Amounts of EEG Data
items.verification: Publisher full article read; Original Research, 23 June 2021; masked contrastive objective and TUEG source verified.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG; unseen downstream subjects, datasets and acquisition hardware; multiple BCI/EEG classification tasks; transfer regime dependent.

items.title: Time-Series Representation Learning via Temporal and Contextual Contrasting
items.verification: Official proceedings abstract and paper verified; main track, not workshop.
items.evidence_scope: Generic time-series SSL with direct scalp EEG sleep-stage evidence among three datasets; not a dedicated multi-corpus EEG foundation model.

items.title: BIOT: Biosignal Transformer for Cross-data Learning in the Wild
items.venue: NeurIPS 2023, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36, 78240–78260
items.verification: Official main-conference proceedings and full PDF verified; Section 2.3 unsupervised pretraining uses channel/token dropout and contrastive loss. Also includes supervised pretraining settings.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG clinical tasks including seizure and abnormal/event detection; also ECG and human-activity modalities. Mixed-modality scope is explicitly flagged.

items.title: Large Brain Model for Learning Generic Representations with Tremendous EEG Data in BCI
items.verification: Official conference proceedings verified; LaBraM name, authors, two-stage spectral VQ and masked neural-code prediction, ~2500 h/~20 datasets verified.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG: abnormal detection, event type, emotion, gait; does not establish PROTEUS three-class performance.

items.title: EEG2Rep: Enhancing Self-supervised EEG Representation Through Informative Masked Inputs
items.verification: ACM DOI page blocked by HTTP 403. Author institutional publication record supplies final published version, full authors, exact proceedings, pages and publication date 25 August 2024; not inferred from a preprint.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG six tasks, subject variability, latent target prediction and semantic subsequence preserving; no claim of causal online adaptation.

items.title: EEGPT: Pretrained Transformer for Universal and Reliable Representation of EEG Signals
items.venue: NeurIPS 2024, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37
items.verification: Official main-conference proceedings and PDF verified. HTML has first-author typo Guagnyu; paper author normalized to Guangyu.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG: motor imagery, ERP, sleep; dual SSL signal reconstruction and representation alignment; frozen linear-probe evidence.

items.title: CBraMod: A Criss-Cross Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding
items.verification: Official proceedings verified; separate parallel spatial/temporal attention, asymmetric positional encoding, masked raw EEG reconstruction; 10 tasks/12 datasets.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG and broad BCI tasks, not intracranial inference; task-specific transfer protocols require matching.

items.title: NeuroLM: A Universal Multi-task Foundation Model for Bridging the Gap between Language and EEG Signals
items.verification: Official proceedings verified; VQ temporal-frequency tokenizer, multichannel autoregression, instruction tuning; ~25000 h and six downstream datasets.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG with language-model interface; no evidence for arbitrary thought reading or PROTEUS word-class decoding.

items.title: REVE: A Foundation Model for EEG - Adapting to Any Setup with Large-Scale Pretraining on 25,000 Subjects
items.venue: NeurIPS 2025, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38, Main Conference Track
items.verification: Official proceedings and PDF verified; confirmed main conference, not preprint/workshop; 4D positional encoding, masked autoencoding, >60000 h/92 datasets/25000 subjects.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG ten tasks including MI, seizure, sleep, cognitive load and emotion. Pretraining overlap audit remains necessary for a new benchmark.

items.title: LUNA: Efficient and Topology-Agnostic Foundation Model for EEG Signal Analysis
items.venue: NeurIPS 2025, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38, Main Conference Track
items.verification: Official main-conference proceedings verified; learned queries/cross-attention fixed latent, masked reconstruction, TUEG/Siena >21000 raw hours.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG abnormality, artifact, slowing and emotion; no direct MI/counting/word PROTEUS demonstration.

items.title: CSBrain: A Cross-scale Spatiotemporal Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding
items.venue: NeurIPS 2025, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38, Main Conference Track
items.verification: Official proceedings verifies title/authors/main-track/year and 11 tasks/16 datasets. Proceedings PDF exceeds browser size limit; primary OpenReview paper indexed text verifies masked reconstruction objective.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG 11 tasks/16 datasets; cross-scale tokenization and structured sparse attention; no causal target-stream evaluation claimed.

items.title: NeurIPT: Foundation Model for Neural Interfaces
items.venue: NeurIPS 2025, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38, Main Conference Track
items.verification: Official main-conference proceedings verified; amplitude-aware masked pretraining, progressive MoE, 3D coordinates, intra/inter lobe pooling; nine downstream BCI datasets.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG BCI datasets, fine-tuning and scratch evaluation. Coordinate input means known montage, not permission to use target subject/session metadata.

items.title: EEGMamba: An EEG foundation model with Mamba
items.verification: Publisher article indexed content verifies title/authors, journal volume, article number, December 2025 issue and abstract; direct open returns HTTP 403. Publisher confirms bidirectional Mamba and masked patch reconstruction; 16724 h/five pretraining datasets, six downstream tasks/datasets.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG BCI tasks; bidirectional encoder does not imply causal processing across future target windows.

items.title: Are EEG Foundation Models Worth It? Comparative Evaluation with Traditional Decoders in Diverse BCI Tasks
items.verification: Official ICLR 2026 conference proceedings verified; ST-EEGFormer explicitly introduced as ViT+raw-signal MAE on >8M segments; six protocols. Not counted as merely a review.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG comparison; data-scarce settings and frozen linear probing often fail to beat compact/classical decoders; benchmark protocols differ from causal PROTEUS.

items.title: CodeBrain: Bridging Decoupled Tokenizer and Multi-Scale Architecture for EEG Foundation Model
items.verification: Official ICLR 2026 proceedings and 49-page paper verified; TFDual-Tokenizer separate time/frequency codebooks; EEGSSM predicts discrete tokens for masked patches; eight tasks/ten datasets. Exact accepted title uses singular Model.
items.evidence_scope: Direct scalp EEG with cohort/channel shifts; token interpretability is representational association, not validated causal source localization.
